newsitem.title: USA: Singapore Telecom cuts Executive stake.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Telecom cuts Executive stake.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd said on Monday it cuts its stake in Executive TeleCard Ltd to 603,600 common shares, or 3.8 percent of the outstanding stock.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Singapore Telecom said its latest transactions include sales of 140,000 common shares between August 20 and September 19 at prices ranging from $8.51 to $11.125 per share.
Singapore Telecom said that, depending on its evaluation of Executive's business and other factors, it may continue to sell or otherwise dispose of common shares.
